DAOONO Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, west Triangle, Quezon City ph OILG OPINION NO. _TI S. 20t5_ JUN 13 2025 ARKEY DEL MUNDO REMOQUILLO 484 Soleville Subdivision, Barangay Talipapa, Quezon City Dear Mr. Remoquillo: This refers to your letter dated 17 September 2024, requesting this Department's legal opinion on the following matters: l. Whether the fees charged by the barangay for the issuance of a Certificate to File Action (CFA) are reasonable; and 2. The legal basis, if any, for charging fees for the CFA. Based on your representation, you filed a complaint against Mr. Mark G. Carlos before Barangay Bagbag for alleged physical injuries and verbal abuse. However, Mr. Carlos failed to appear at the scheduled hearing, prompting the barangay to issue a CFA. You further stated that Barangay Bagbag charged you a total amount of Seven Hundred Fifty Pesos (Php 750.00) for the issuance of the CFA. At the outset, we shall address both queries collectively, as they are interrelated. Please be informed that barangays are not authorized to impose or collect fees for the issuance of a CFA. Any such charge is, therefore, considered unreasonable and without legal basis. It is important to emphasize that under Section 152(d) of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991, there is no express provision allowing barangays to levy fees or charges related to the processing of a case that is yet to be filed in court. In view of the foregoing, we opine that a barangay has no authority to impose or collect fees for the issuance of a CFA. Any such practice is inconsistent with the provisions of the Local Government Code and must be discontinued. We appreciate you bringing this matter to our attention. Rest assured that this Department will continue to monitor such concerns to ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations. "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

This Opinion is rendered based solely on the facts and representations stated in your letter and our appreciation thereof. We hope this sufficiently addresses your concerns. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ROMEO P. BENITEZ A Undersecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSELLA'RPBILLLS-LRALLDnasm Page 2 of 2
